rule_hypotheses.rule: Payout = min(Max Benefit from sheet, covered outstanding balance after excluding non-covered categories and subtracting any cash deposit held).
Sheet 'Max Benefit' is the cap even when the lease addendum states a different waived-deposit amount (Perry Reid addenda say $1,200, paid up to/over that with Max 1500).
Rent-based cap (rent rounded up to next $500) is NOT generally applied in late-2023/2024 claims.

Utilities: charges for utilities consumed after move-out / during vacancy-make-ready are excluded, while the tenant's final utility bill for the occupancy period is paid (PM Explanation on 1013 still says utilities not eligible generally).
Pet odor treatments (ozone purifiers) are excluded.
A cash security deposit actually collected is subtracted; payout equals PM's 'balance after deductions'.
Short holdover proration after lease end (a few days) is paid; claims consisting only of post-lease-end notice rent plus late fees get $0 (declined).

When the PM's itemization contains only covered-looking categories, the adjuster pays the bottom line without carving out small embedded fees (e.g., a month of fee-in-lieu bundled with trash removal).
Excalibur Homes (GR0028) 2023 claims were paid at exactly Max Benefit, often with only an SD addendum and a no-refund letter on file (no itemization).
Agreed/collected tenant settlement amounts do not reduce the approved benefit (they are subrogation recoveries).
Late fees, admin fees, SD insurance/premium charges, credit-reporting/service fees and eviction-cancellation fees are excluded (when the cap does not bind they would be removed).
Declined claims with no Policy # / no Max Benefit on the sheet indicate no active policy/premium.

extraction_lessons: Workbook 'Comments' sheet is keyed by 'Row N' but comment dates often predate the claim (Row 1014 comments 10/2023 vs claim 1013 dated 12/2024; Row 267 03/2023 vs claim 10/2023); treat comments as misaligned/unreliable.

Texas TXR-2216 'Itemization of Security Deposit' PDFs (Reedy Creek, StarPointe) often have garbled or empty text layers; render visually. 'Total amount of Security Deposit tendered' shows any cash deposit to subtract; 'Balance after deductions' (negative) is the PM's claim.
StarPointe Propertyware ledgers: rows marked 'Unpaid Charge' are the move-out claim; 'Paid Charge' rows are history. Balance column runs bottom-up.

Excalibur Homes statements: full-period running statement with 'Balance Due'; contains many excluded fees (Sec Dep Ins Charge, Pinata Service Fee, EFT service fees, TBR late charges, admin fee, eviction cancellation) plus a reversal of post-vacate rent. Compute covered = balance - excluded fees.

AppFolio (Property Mgmt Svs Columbus OH) Gmail demand letters are unfilled templates; use the stated total and the tenant ledger's post-move-out 'Move-out Inspection Charges' and 'Utility Reimbursement Fee' lines. Sheet Monthly Rent there includes the $19.95 waiver fee and $20 garbage.

Perry Reid: Move Out Letter states the balance; the docx ledger repeats columns (duplicated text) and turnover charges are dated the move-out letter date; also an SDI form ('Security Deposit Itemization - Move Out') with (A) outstanding + (B) maintenance totals.

Century 21 Accent Homes: statement where rent/fees are fully paid and move-out items appear as 'Security Deposit Deduction'; vendor invoices back individual items. Folder can include tenant-side evidence (tenant-paid carpet receipts, utility portal screenshots) that must not be added.
Lease addendum waived-deposit amounts can disagree with sheet Max Benefit (754, 952: $1,200 vs 1500; 1013: $4,400 vs 4500); the sheet value appears to be what adjusters capped at.
Sheet lease dates can be wrong (1013 shows 2022-10-01..2024-11-30 while the lease is 10/1/2024..9/30/2025); prefer document dates when judging rent-after-lease-end.
Tenant-contact screenshots (Excalibur) are PII-only and carry no claim data.
When Max Benefit binds (303, 754, 627), the exclusions cannot be validated; such claims are weak evidence for category rules.
